sar.narrative: On December 1, 2016, at 17:28:53, an online transaction of $99.92 (transaction ID 3503878) was attempted using card C07987-K2. The real-time fraud model scored this transaction at 0.90, indicating a high risk of unauthorized activity. The transaction originated from a new device profile running Windows and Chrome 61.0, which had never been seen before on this card. Further network analysis revealed that this same device profile was used across four other cards within a fourteen-day window, all associated with high-risk transactions and forty-three confirmed closed fraud cases. This shared device origin demonstrates a coordinated fraud ring operating across multiple accounts. Therefore, the transaction is deemed suspicious, warranting a formal SAR filing and card blocking to prevent further financial exposure.

stop_reason: Probability 0.98 >= 0.85 with 3 independent evidence groups; no evidence request is needed and further steps would not change the decision.
